column3: Painterly digital background painting for a dark nautical fantasy roguelike deckbuilder, rich oil-paint texture, deep teal and sea-green palette with cold turquoise glows and warm lantern-gold light, matching a set of moody painted cave scenes. Wide 3:2 landscape, no people, no creatures, no text, no letters, no frame. The scene: a vast cave chamber full of air, deep below a lighthouse. Old stone stairs cut by long-gone keepers descend along the left wall to a ledge of wet flagstones in the foreground. Beyond the ledge the chamber floor is still, black water held unnaturally high, with faint turquoise glows deep under its surface. There is no sunlight: the only warm light is a lantern glow spilling from the lower left onto the stone, and cold turquoise glimmers on the water and on pale growths on the walls. Old iron mooring rings in the stone and a rotted pier post. Keep the lower third calm and dark, and keep the centre and right open, because creatures and the interface are drawn over it.
